About

Software engineer working in Go, Python, TypeScript and Rust across security, data, infrastructure and AI. Founding Engineer at TraceGraph.

I turn recurring engineering work into platforms: the systems, automation, and observability that help teams ship faster without trading away reliability.

Most of how I build comes from a short shelf of books, a longer stack of papers, and systems that broke in production. Right now that means distributed systems and evals for AI agents.

Self-taught. I love engineering, code, coffee, data and rockets.
